dedupe_keys.name: clear collaborative air quality data directory edf

description: The Air Quality Data Directory is a searchable, filterable catalogue of air pollutant emission databases and tools, built by the Environmental Defense Fund with partners and clean air advocates to help people find data for legal action and advocacy. Entries are classed as datasets or tools and filtered by data category (demographics, emissions, facility compliance and enforcement, facility production and processes, ground-based monitoring, health outcomes, modelled exposure), pollutant (benzene, criteria pollutants, greenhouse gases, hazardous air pollutants, TRI chemicals, VOCs and others) and spatial extent, from global to US Gulf Coast states. Examples include the AirToxScreen mapping tool, Carbon Mapper, Climate TRACE, Envirofacts TRI search, EPA refinery fenceline benzene data, the FLIGHT greenhouse gas tool and FencelineData.org. It is hosted on Clear Collaborative. Coverage is mainly the United States. The directory is available free online, and users can suggest resources by form or email. Caveats: the site warns that some listed datasets and tools are no longer available and keeps a separate list of archives and workarounds. For simulation it is a finding aid for emission and exposure data around industrial facilities. It is related to the Clear Collaborative Petrochemical Air Pollution Map record in this catalogue.
